title: Interactive Tools With Visible Process
description:
All tools must be interactive and the user must see how the algorithms think by seeing the process, so wrong settings are spotted faster and intuition builds. Every tool can show progress (steps, percentage, status). Puzzle 3d fill tool first: drop the hidden precompute-everything-then-reveal logic; nothing is hidden or precomputed, the solution builds up interactively in front of the user. The fill count slider is unbounded, arbitrarily settable and defaults to 100. The UI shows every object it tries and locks: danger-colored mesh on collision, highlighted when collision free.

Coordination: Fable 5.1 High main chat plans; Opus 5 High agents execute; Sonnet 5 High agents explore/audit read-only. Maximum parallel fleet. Other agents work concurrently on the same files; do not stop, work in conjunction. Bookkeeping is manual on disk because the repo MCP failed to connect (invalid initialize params) at session start. Reopened 2026-09-13 ~22:00 (Opus 5 session ⚪7c7fb230): every tool has a lifecycle start → running (live progress: steps, percentage, status) → complete, can be aborted at any time and finalized only when complete; a tool mutating the artifact runs inside a transaction (abort rolls back, finalize commits). Puzzle 3d fill shows ALL tested meshes in 3d, colored by verdict (collision = danger, fitting = success). Reopened 2026-09-14 (Fable 5.1 session ⚪629f0bae, Windows checkout C:/git/semio, repo MCP connect timeout so bookkeeping stays manual): get the React renderer working end to end before the wgpu renderer. Puzzle 3d fill in the React shell must show every tested mesh in 3d, danger-colored on collision and success-colored when it fits, with the run started, aborted and finalized (only when complete) from the UI.
